programs.name: Ward Run
programs.description: v1.5.1 phone app for the daily ward stock run. Shared day, week and stock records (no login — anyone with the link can see them); each phone still works offline. The Order tab on-hand figure is full boxes, and turns red at 5 boxes or fewer. The Stock tab shows remaining stock as boxes plus loose packets. Set a par in whole boxes per hospital and item on the Stock tab (shared). The Order tab shows par and on hand now, and pre-fills order quantity as the shortfall (par minus on hand) in whole boxes when a par is set; items without a par stay empty. Quantities stay editable, boxes only; WhatsApp is in boxes. Stocktake converts box and each deliveries to one packet total using packets per box, and remaining stock is shown as boxes plus loose packets. History can print or download Excel by day, week or month, including today. Weekly summary, History and Excel show packets (ea) and the box equivalent side by side, per ward per item. Each ward’s fluid list puts Popular (most-used from shared history) at the top, then all other fluids, nothing hidden, and the lists are more compact. First open is a Gerardo / Prabin / Guest picker. A confirm warning appears before live changes, except for Prabin in POW and Gerardo in Children’s; Guest always sees it.

programs.name: Stocktake
programs.description: v1.3.2 · Photo or video the coolroom or shelves; AI reads labels and counts stock (case maths, hidden-stock estimate). Guessed rows show red with a Check column, each item has a photo crop (also in Excel), hard labels get a close-up re-read, and a Stocktake sheet exports as Excel or PDF.
